title: Physiology: Muscle Contraction & Reflexes
description: Study notes for the Block 1.2 physiology practicum: skeletal muscle structure, the contraction mechanism, contraction phenomena (twitch, treppe, summation, tetanus, fatigue), reflexes and the reflex examination, and a guide to the frog wet lab and PhysioEx dry lab.
